reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to PlantSense again
reauth_confirm.description: PlantSense needs you to sign in again. You'll go to the PlantSense sign-in page, where you can use Google, Apple or your email, the same way you sign in to the app.

abort.already_configured: This PlantSense account is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: Signed in again. PlantSense is reconnected.
abort.wrong_account: That's a different PlantSense account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up with.
abort.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach PlantSense. Try again in a moment.
abort.invalid_api_url: The PLANTSENSE_API_URL override must start with https:// or http://.
abort.user_rejected_authorize: The connection was cancelled on the PlantSense page.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: Timed out preparing the PlantSense sign-in. Try again.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no URL configured, so PlantSense can't send you back to it. See {docs_url}.
abort.missing_configuration: The PlantSense sign-in isn't available. Restart Home Assistant and try again.
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: The PlantSense sign-in isn't available. Restart Home Assistant and try again.
abort.oauth_error: PlantSense sent back an invalid sign-in. Try again.
abort.oauth_failed: Couldn't finish signing in to PlantSense. Try again.
abort.oauth_timeout: PlantSense took too long to finish signing in. Try again.
abort.oauth_unauthorized: PlantSense refused the sign-in. Try again.

progress.auth: Finish signing in on the PlantSense page that opened.
